# Get Zone Authorization Token Info [zone.getAuthorizationTokenInfo]

Returns the authenticated account address and token expiry from the current authorization token.

## Usage

:::code-group

```ts twoslash [example.ts]
// @twoslash-cache: {"v":1,"hash":"369d2faee1a0d3579590c2cdf656f223f13956aabcd8cd4226c4e71ae153a003","data":""}
import { client } from './viem.config'

const info = await client.zone.getAuthorizationTokenInfo()

console.log('Account:', info.account)
console.log('Expires At:', info.expiresAt)
// @log: Account: 0x742d35Cc6634C0532925a3b844Bc9e7595f0bEbb
// @log: Expires At: 1717027200n
```

```ts twoslash [viem.config.ts] filename="viem.config.ts"
// @twoslash-cache: {"v":1,"hash":"a57ef5436b6bcd3f320cc085c065fe4b69419ffb0305348d36e1f041a72ebceb","data":""}
// [!include ~/snippets/tempo/viem.config.ts:setup]
```

:::

## Recipes

### Re-Sign Before the Token Expires

Combine the token expiry with [`zone.signAuthorizationToken`](/tempo/actions/zone.signAuthorizationToken) to refresh authentication in a long-running service before zone requests start failing.

:::code-group

```ts twoslash [example.ts]
// @twoslash-cache: {"v":1,"hash":"2323d06d86a835ab2bef045e3a9977d89376d4547e4cc88974cb6121bcd5c12b","data":""}
import { client } from './viem.config'

const { expiresAt } = await client.zone.getAuthorizationTokenInfo()

const oneHour = 60n * 60n
const now = BigInt(Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000))

if (expiresAt - now < oneHour) // [!code focus]
  await client.zone.signAuthorizationToken() // [!code focus]
```

```ts twoslash [viem.config.ts] filename="viem.config.ts"
// @twoslash-cache: {"v":1,"hash":"a57ef5436b6bcd3f320cc085c065fe4b69419ffb0305348d36e1f041a72ebceb","data":""}
// [!include ~/snippets/tempo/viem.config.ts:setup]
```

:::

## Return Value

```ts
type ReturnType = {
  /** Authenticated account address. */
  account: Address
  /** Token expiry as a unix timestamp. */
  expiresAt: bigint
}
```

The authorization token info.
